alarm.$description: Alarm. The colour of a broken or failed state, and only that. Written literally in the prototype rather than themed, deliberately: no theme may redefine what "broken" looks like.

alarm-soft.$description: Alarm fill, low opacity. Non-themeable, same reasoning as --alarm.

alarm-line.$description: Alarm border/line, reduced opacity. Non-themeable, same reasoning as --alarm.

alarm-ink.$description: Text/icon colour for content on a solid --alarm fill (the primary action button on Warning/Error). Not in the prototype: renderCallout() used var(--bg) for this, which fails AA in the light theme (2.03:1) since --bg is themeable but --alarm is not. Non-themeable by necessity — proposed pending the token decisions ticket, flagged in the PR.
